additional_info.subject: Handover notes
additional_info.body:
Charging blocked at State 1 – multiple attempts required to start
charging
• Charging session gets stuck at State 1 (EV connection /
initialization).
• The user needs to retry multiple times before the charge
eventually starts.
• This issue occurs with all vehicles, so it cannot be attributed to a
specific EV.
• The problem is only observed on this charger.
Actions performed:
• Several connection attempts made → charge starts only after
multiple retries.
• Cross-checked with different vehicles → same behavior.
Status: Repeated charging failure at State 1 – technical
investigation required

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0445278-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R5 170001829]Charging blocked at State 1 CRM:02698000440
additional_info.body:
Bonjour Florian,
Merci pour ce ticket très détaillé.
Le problème provenait d’une perte de communication entre notre SECC et notre PLC :
2025-08-21T10:08:02.158723+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [daemon:info] bash[6392]: 2025/08/21 10:08:02 [error] 22#22: *3 connect() to [2600:9000:235a:e000:5:e77e:65c0:93a1]:443 failed (101: Network unreachable) while connecting to upstream, client: 10.20.17.101, server: , request: "POST /log-upload HTTP/1.1", upstream: "https://[2600:9000:235a:e000:5:e77e:65c0:93a1]:443/v1/log-upload", host: "10.20.17.14:8444"
Un redémarrage a permis de résoudre le problème. D’ailleurs, je peux voir que des sessions de charge ont eu lieu sur DC1 au cours des trois derniers jours.
Je recommande de mettre à jour le chargeur vers la version V8.0.5, qui corrige ce défaut de communication :
Puis-je clôturer ce ticket ou avez-vous besoin de plus d’informations ?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
